# arin_whois_delegation (Data Source)

Read a public delegation registration through Whois-RWS, including typed fields and complete XML. No API key is sent. Missing records, partial responses and referrals remain errors. Public data may omit private registration fields.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
data "arin_whois_delegation" "example" {
  name         = "2.0.192.in-addr.arpa."
  show_details = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Reverse DNS delegation name. Case and an optional trailing dot are normalized.

### Optional

- `show_details` (Boolean) Ask ARIN to expand related information inline. Complete XML preserves extra records; any nested truncation is rejected. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (List of String) Ordered lines of comments.
- `ds_records` (Attributes List) ds records returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ds_records))
- `nameservers` (List of String) nameservers returned by ARIN.
- `rdap_ref` (String) rdap ref returned by ARIN.
- `ref` (String) ref returned by ARIN.
- `registration_date` (String) registration date returned by ARIN.
- `update_date` (String) update date returned by ARIN.
- `whois_xml` (String) Complete Whois-RWS XML, preserving references, metadata and extensions. No links are followed.

<a id="nestedatt--ds_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ds_records`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm` (Number) algorithm returned by ARIN.
- `digest` (String) digest returned by ARIN.
- `digest_type` (Number) digest type returned by ARIN.
- `key_tag` (Number) key tag returned by ARIN.
